250-779-1479-6620-8293.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
250-779-1479-6620-8293.notablePrerequisites: You have a number of cards in hand that is above your maximum hand size.
250-779-1479-6620-8293.description:
Play Dakmor Salvage.
When Dakmor Salvage enters, Cleveland Booker and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, choosing to put nothing onto the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Sylvan Safekeeper by sacrificing Dakmor Salvage.
The Gitrog Monster's second ability triggers, causing you to mill two cards and return Dakmor Salvage from your graveyard to your hand.
If a land was milled this way, The Gitrog Monster's second ability triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Sylvan Safekeeper ability
Resolve the Cleveland Booker trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers, putting Dakmor Salvage from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Dakmor Salvage enters the battlefield, Cleveland Booker triggers.
Repeat from step 4.
Proceed to your cleanup step, and discard Dakmor Salvage and any other card(s) as needed down to your maximum hand size.
The Gitrog Monster triggers, causing you to mill two cards and return Dakmor Salvage from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat, as you will still be over your maximum hand size and will be required to discard again.

2023-4068-4518-6723.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Mountain.
2023-4068-4518-6723.description:
Cast Kor Skyfisher by paying its mana cost.
Aragorn triggers, creating a 1/1 Human Soldier creature token.
When Kor Skyfisher enters, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Kor Skyfisher and the Human Soldier token by tapping them, adding {1}{W}.
Resolve the Kor Skyfisher ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

1115-2105-5778-7392.description:
Cast Combat Celebrant by paying {2}{R} plus an additional {2} for its offspring cost.
When Combat Celebrant enters, its offspring ability triggers, creating a token copy of it that is 1/1.
At the beginning of your combat phase, Nesting Dovehawk triggers, creating a copy of the Combat Celebrant token.
Declare a Combat Celebrant token as an attacker, choosing to exert it as it attacks. It then triggers, untapping all other creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat from step 3 each combat phase.

522-997--5.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing the creature with persist.
When that creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to Melira.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

2204-3899-6972.description:
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing Scholar of New Horizons.
When Scholar of New Horizons dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability.
Repeat.

4067-5060-5078-7914.notablePrerequisites: There is an artifact card exiled with Cemetery Prowler.
4067-5060-5078-7914.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding a card, untapping Iron Lad.
Activate Iron Lad by tapping it, revealing Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library and then drawing it.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top by paying {0} due to Cemetery Prowler.
Repeat

1619-2292-4605-5542-6146.notablePrerequisites: You are able to complete a dungeon.
1619-2292-4605-5542-6146.description:
Complete a dungeon.
Sefris' second ability triggers twice due to Delney.
Resolve the first trigger, returning up to one other creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the second trigger, returning Ravenloft Adventurer from your graveyard onto the battlefield.
When Ravenloft Adventurer enters, it triggers once and Preston triggers twice due to Delney.
Holding priority, activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Ravenloft Adventurer.
Resolve a Preston trigger, creating a token copy of Ravenloft Adventurer that is a 0/1 Illusion.
When the Ravenloft Adventurer token enters, it triggers twice due to Delney.
Resolve the Ravenloft Adventurer token triggers, venturing into Undercity twice.
Resolve the second Preston trigger from step 5, creating a token copy of Ravenloft Adventurer that is a 0/1 Illusion.
Repeat steps 8 and 9 one additional time.
Resolve the Ravenloft Adventurer trigger from step 5, venturing into Undercity and completing Undercity.
Repeat from step 2.
1619-2292-4605-5542-6146.notes: You can choose whatever path you desire while venturing through Undercity.

Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to Bloodspore Thrinax
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat

240-5256-5470-7175.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing a player to mill a number of cards equal to the sacrificed creature's power
Repeat from step 2.

1978-4131-7290.description:
Animate Basalt Monolith using Does Machines.
Activate Basalt Monolith by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Basalt Monolith.
Repeat from step 2.

1329-1778-2178-2981.notablePrerequisites: Emry does not have summoning sickness.
1329-1778-2178-2981.description:
Activate Emry by tapping it, allowing you to cast Memnite from your graveyard this turn.
Cast Memnite from your graveyard by paying {0}.
Activate Megatog by sacrificing Memnite.
When Memnite dies, Emry triggers, untapping Emry.
Resolve the Megatog ability.
Repeat.

2034-5434-5541-5555.notablePrerequisites:
Bazaar Trader does not have summoning sickness.
You control a face-down creature whose front face is a permanent card.
2034-5434-5541-5555.description:
Activate Bazaar Trader by tapping it, giving control of Karlov Watchdog to an opponent.
During the opponent's turn, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a face-down creature you control, adding {C}{C}.
When the creature dies, Yarus's second ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield face-down as a 2/2 creature, and then not turning it face-up due to Karlov Watchdog.
Repeat from step 2.

719-1429-2438-5402.notablePrerequisites: Lesser Masticore does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
719-1429-2438-5402.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Lesser Masticore.
When Lesser Masticore dies,  its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Lesser Masticore enters the battlefield, Captain Storm triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Lesser Masticore.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat.

359-372-2556.notablePrerequisites: You have any number of other nonland permanents that enter the battlefield untapped, and that can collectively tap to produce enough mana to cast Acrobatic Maneuver exiled by Abdel Adrian.
359-372-2556.description:
Cast Acrobatic Maneuver by paying its mana cost, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, returning Mnemonic Wall and all other cards that were exiled with it to the battlefield.
Abdel Adrian and Mnemonic Wall trigger.
Resolve the Mnemonic Wall trigger, returning Acrobatic Maneuver from your graveyard to your hand.
Holding priority, activate any number of nonland permanents you control by tapping them, adding at least enough mana to cast Acrobatic Maneuver.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling Mnemonic Wall and the mana-producing permanents until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token for each permanent exiled this way.
Repeat.

1486-3459-4875--67.description:
Activate the Vehicle's crew ability by tapping Battered Golem.
Magda triggers, creating a Treasure token.
When the Treasure enters the battlefield, Battered Golem triggers, untapping Battered Golem.
Resolve the crew ability.
Repeat.

1993-2979-4543.notablePrerequisites:
You have at least one land card in hand.
Patchwork Crawler does not have summoning sickness.
Trench Behemoth and Budoka Gardener exiled by Patchwork Crawler.
1993-2979-4543.description:
Activate Patchwork Crawler using Budoka Gardener's ability by tapping it, putting a land from your hand onto the battlefield.
If the land is mana-producing and enters the battlefield untapped, you may activate it by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Activate Patchwork Crawler using Trench Behemoth's ability by returning the land from the battlefield to your hand, untapping Patchwork Crawler.
Repeat.

4050-4871-5433.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Treasure.
4050-4871-5433.description:
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {R}.
Krenko triggers, causing you to pay {R} to create a 1/1 Goblin creature token with haste.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Goblin token, adding one mana of any color.
When the Goblin dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Repeat.

2169-4613-5507.notablePrerequisites: You control another creature that has at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
2169-4613-5507.description:
Activate Zameck Guildmage's first ability by paying {G}{U}, causing each creature you control to enter the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it this turn.
Activate another creature you control that has a +1/+1 counter on it by exiling it, creating a 1/1 Human creature token that enters the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it due to Renata.
Repeat step 2 using the Human token instead.

1063-1633-2060-3231-4120.description:
Cast Hanabi Blast by paying {1}{R}{R}, targeting Crystalline Crawler.
Resolve Hanabi Blast, putting four +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler due to Vigor's first ability, and then returning Hanabi Blast to your hand and discarding a card at random.
Oskar triggers if the discarded card was a nonland card.
Holding priority, activate Crystalline Crawler;s first ability three times by removing three +1/+1 counters from it, adding {1}{R}{R}.
Resolve the Oskar trigger, choosing to cast Hanabi Blast if it was the discarded card by paying {1}{R}{R} targeting Crystalline Crawler, or choosing not to cast the card otherwise.
If you did not cast Hanabi Blast using Oskar, cast it from your hand by paying {1}{R}{R}, targeting Crystalline Crawler.
Repeat from step 2.
Once you have infinite colored mana, you may instead target any other creature and/or player with Hanabi Blast.

the Warped Eclipse.

513-2454-3923-4668.description:

Cast Mystic Speculation with buyback by paying {U}.
Hullbreaker Horror triggers, returning Chromatic Lantern to your hand from the battlefield.
Resolve Mystic Speculation, causing you to scry 3 and returning Mystic Speculation to your hand.
Cast Chromatic Lantern by paying {0}.
Repeat.

2-198-1651-1822.notablePrerequisites:
Empowered Autogenerator has at least three charge counters on it.
You control a nontoken noncreature artifact with mana value less than or equal to the number of charge counters on Empowered Autogenerator minus three.
2-198-1651-1822.description:
Activate Empowered Autogenerator by tapping it, putting a charge counter on it and adding at least {4}.
Cast Ancestral Statue by paying {4}.
When Ancestral Statue enters the battlefield, it triggers twice.
Holding priority, activate Clock of Omens by tapping the nontoken noncreature artifact and Ancestral Statue, untapping Empowered Autogenerator.
Resolve both Ancestral Statue triggers, returning it and the nontoken noncreature artifact to your hand.
Cast the noncreature artifact by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

2060-4153-4772.notablePrerequisites: A creature you control besides Crystalline Crawler has at least five +1/+1 counters on it.
2060-4153-4772.description:
Activate Resourceful Defense by paying {4}{W}, removing at least five +1/+1 counters from a creature you control and putting at least ten +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability five times by removing five +1/+1 counters, adding {4}{W}.
Activate Resourceful Defense by paying {4}{W}, removing five +1/+1 counters from Crystalline Crawler and putting ten +1/+1 counters on another creature you control.
Activate Resourceful Defense by paying {4}{W}, removing ten +1/+1 counters from that creature and putting twenty +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability ten times by removing ten +1/+1 counters, adding {8}{W}{W}.
Repeat from step 3 any number of times.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability any number of times.
2060-4153-4772.notes: Note that the starting mana can come from activating Crystalline Crawler's mana ability. Starting mana is reduced if the creature starts with more than five +1/+1 counters on it.

1765-3161-4050.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Spirit.
1765-3161-4050.description:
Cast Reins of the Vinesteed by paying {3}{G}, attaching it to a Spirit.
Reins of the Vinesteed enters the battlefield, triggering Chishiro, creating a 2/2 Spirit token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the creature with Reins of the Vinesteed attached, adding one mana of any color.
The creature dies, triggering Reins of the Vinesteed, returning Reins of the Vinesteed from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to a Spirit.
Reins of the Vinesteed enters the battlefield, triggering Chishiro, creating a 2/2 Spirit token.
Repeat from step 3.

679-2498.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card.
679-2498.description:
Draw a card.
Sheoldred's first ability triggers, causing you to gain two life.
Lich's Mastery's first ability triggers, causing you to draw two cards.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.n: Runo Stromkirk // Krothuss, Lord of the Deep

1367-3482-3838.notablePrerequisites:
Rune-Scarred Demon and Krothuss do not have summoning sickness.
An opponent is unable to block and kill Krothuss and Rune-Scarred Demon.
1367-3482-3838.description:
Declare Krothuss and Rune-Scarred Demon as attackers.
Krothuss triggers, creating a token copy of Rune-Scarred Demon that is tapped and attacking.
The Rune-Scarred Demon token enters the battlefield, causing you to search your library for Nexus of Fate and put it into your hand.
Cast Nexus of Fate by paying {5}{U}{U}, causing you to take an extra turn after this one and shuffle Nexus of Fate into your library.
Repeat each turn.

1976-3532-3761-5078.easyPrerequisites: There is a removable counter on a creature you control.
1976-3532-3761-5078.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Arcbound Crusher triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Arcbound Crusher.
Repeat.

249-1984-4406.notablePrerequisites: Zethi does not have summoning sickness.
249-1984-4406.description:
Declare Zethi as an attacker.
Zethi triggers, copying all cards you own in exile with kick counters on them and allowing you to cast the copies.
Cast the Chance for Glory and Angel's Grace copies by paying {1}{W}{W}{R}.
Resolve the Chance for Glory copy, causing you to take an extra turn after this one and lose the game at the end of the extra turn.
Resolve the Angel's Grace copy, preventing you from losing the game this turn.
At the beginning of each extra turn's end step, Chance for Glory triggers, however you cannot lose the game due to Angel's Grace.
Repeat each turn.
